submittedParameters.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE final independent traditional Chinese festival event banner for the Taoist fantasy game 五行奇谈.
Canvas: target native 2098 × 749 pixels, very wide landscape 2.8:1, opaque edge-to-edge illustration. Never a whole interface or a contact sheet.
Input image 1 is the PRIMARY approved style, chibi-character and horizontal-composition reference. Input image 2 is the approved mail interface context; use its painting quality only, never copy UI frames, borders, controls or writing.
Preserve the reference's refined rounded Chinese hand-painted fantasy art: precise polished contours, full rounded shapes, rich but restrained painterly detail, convincing cloth/stone/foliage volumes, jade and teal landscape, ivory cloth, warm gold accents, clean air and soft depth. Luminous but properly exposed highlights. Premium 2D illustration, not flat vector or plastic 3D.
Character on the RIGHT THIRD: one small chibi Taoist boy, the same large brown eyes, rosy round face, short spiky brown hair, golden headband with knot and two ribbons, jade-green gold-trim vest over ivory robe and trousers, golden yin-yang gourd on belt. Big head and short limbs. Keep his face, hands and all important props within safe edges.
LEFT 45% stays comparatively quiet: softly layered distant scenery and mist or sky, suitable for future overlaid text, but do not paint any text. Foreground thematic props concentrate on the right. Do not place the character on the left.
ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT: no Chinese or English characters, pseudo-writing, numerals, calligraphy, watermark, logo, UI border, graphic frame. Plain lanterns and plain packets must have NO characters. No giant moon, mooncakes, rabbit or Mid-Autumn osmanthus. Change the scene to the festival below instead of copying the reference night setting.
Rendering goal: highest available refined finished painting; the host manages the model and quality.
Festival-specific scene: Theme: Shangsi spring outing festival (上巳). Clear sunlit spring riverside, tender willow leaves and a few peach blossoms. On the right the boy kneels on a rounded stone bank, gently placing one tiny plain wooden cup onto a narrow clear winding stream to float downstream; small iris leaves beside him. Keep the action safe and serene. On the left the stream flows through softly layered fresh green meadows toward distant jade-roof pavilions and misty teal mountains, visually quiet. Spring purification and flowing-water gathering atmosphere, only one boy, no writing.

submittedParameters.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / stylized-concept.
Create one final refined, opaque, edge-to-edge 2098 × 749 horizontal Shangsi festival banner for 五行奇谈. Native canvas and aspect ratio must stay identical to Image 3.

INPUT ORDER: Image 1 is the approved banner painting, character identity, and composition style reference. Image 2 is the approved mail UI painting-quality reference only, never copy any UI, text, panels or borders. Image 3 is the actual current Shangsi banner to edit.

Edit Image 3 with ONE compositional correction: make its LEFT 45% genuinely calm, atmospheric negative space suitable for later dark-green title text. Keep the same soft jade/teal spring palette and refined rounded hand-painted volumes; replace the dense left mountains, many pavilions, waterfalls, numerous flower clusters and sharp foreground stones with broad softly lit ivory-blue spring sky and haze above low distant softly layered teal hills and a simple quiet pale jade stream/meadow. Use much lower contrast, fewer tiny details, no large foreground flowers on the left, and at most one tiny distant jade-roof pavilion. The left should feel like a natural continuation of this spring scene, not an empty white rectangle or graphic gradient. Transition smoothly through the middle.

PRESERVE the entire right-side main subject and narrative of Image 3: same round-faced big brown-eyed chibi boy, same short spiky brown hair, golden headband with two ribbons, ivory clothes, jade-green gold-trim vest, golden yin-yang gourd at his belt, serene kneeling pose on a round stone bank; the same plain small wooden cup resting on the clear stream at his fingertips, physically touching the water and creating a small ripple. Keep tender willow sprigs, a few peach blossoms, iris leaves/flowers, transparent spring water and soft sunlit texture on the right. Keep a plausible two-arm, two-hand, two-leg body; visible fingers naturally shaped without extra or fused digits; the knees and any shoes consistent with kneeling. Do not crop the head, hands or cup. Do not add characters or props.
Maintain the exact premium 2D hand-painted style and fine details of Image 1 and Image 3: rounded full forms, natural cloth shading, clear contours, warm gold midtones, clean light, never plastic 3D or flat vector.
No lettering, no pseudo-writing, no numerals, no signature, no visible watermark, no logos, no UI frames, no panels, no contact sheet. No moon, rabbit, mooncakes, osmanthus, or night scene. Do not brighten the ivory sleeves to clipped white. Deliver only the one final Shangsi banner.

checks.style: 金发带棕发圆眼道童、玉绿金边米白衣装与温润金葫芦；清雅圆润的精细手绘体积，与两张参考一致。
checks.face: 双眼、嘴与面部轮廓自然，未见明显畸形。
checks.hands: 两只手接触自然；扶石手自然展开，持杯手部分手指被杯沿遮挡，完整五指数不能逐一确认，未见明显多指或断指。
checks.feet: 跪姿与衣裤体积合理；双脚被衣摆、身体和植物遮挡，不能确认两只完整脚，未见多肢或明显错位。
checks.contact: 木杯贴水有连贯涟漪，指尖在杯沿，另一手撑在石岸上。
checks.negativeSpace: 左侧约45%为天空、薄雾远山与开阔水面；一座小远亭，整体低对比，安静空间较首稿显著改善。
checks.text: 未见文字、伪字、标志、可见水印、UI边框或拼图。
checks.exposure: 白衣褶皱、暖金中间调和石岸体积可见，未见明显过曝。
